verdict.rationale: Omarchy's docs say graphics drivers and configuration, including NVIDIA on supported hardware, are set up during installation, which covers the GPU vendor driver half of the story. Nothing in the evidence addresses building custom kernel modules or setting up GPU compute or acceleration stacks for non-gaming workloads. Missing for 10: evidence of custom kernel module building (headers, DKMS or similar), GPU compute/acceleration tooling for developer workloads, and independent hands-on corroboration of driver setup.
